title: PALIMPSEST shared output contract — answer object (v0.1)

status.description: established: holds under every admissible interpretation of the admitted observations (a refuted yes/no proposition is established with assertion=false). possible: a single proposition holds under some but not all interpretations. unresolved: the slot asks for a value and interpretations disagree; alternatives lists them and assertion is null. unknown: no admitted observation bears on the slot.

assertion.description: The answer for established/possible: a canonical value (single-valued slot), a sorted list of values (multi-valued slot), a boolean (yes/no slot), or an object {value: [observation ids]} for a reported slot. null for unresolved/unknown.

alternatives.description: For unresolved: the candidate answers, each a canonical value, a sorted list (multi-valued slot) or null (meaning 'no value'). Empty otherwise.

provenance.description: Observation ids the answer relies on. Validated for actual support, not existence.

explanation.description: Optional free text. Never scored; used only for qualitative error analysis.
